plan_name: Deferred Bonus Plan (DBP) / Annual Bonus Plan 2025
assessment_summary: North American Revenue of $1,322m narrowly missed the threshold of $1,355m (98% of threshold). Below threshold — $0 formulaic payout. Both metrics narrowly missed their respective thresholds. Committee exercised discretion to award 30% of base salary (20% of maximum opportunity of 150%), equal to the minimum/threshold level that would have been paid had both thresholds been met. Rationale included: volatile macroeconomic conditions (evolving tariff policy, general market uncertainty) unforeseen at target-setting; proximity of actual results to threshold; stretch embedded in budget targets; and experience of key stakeholders including employees and shareholders.
additional_conditions: Interdependent with Operating Profit (no standalone weighting; combined grid structure). If revenue growth was below 1%, no bonus was payable regardless of operating profit performance. The grid produced bonus outcomes ranging from 30% of base salary (threshold: revenue $1,355m + operating profit $154m minimum) to 150% of base salary (maximum: revenue $1,465m + operating profit $160m minimum). On-target performance (revenue $1,400m + operating profit $157m minimum) would have yielded 75% of base salary.

assessment_summary: Key areas of focus and achievements: (1) Effective leadership of a team focused on delivering business growth through higher flows and market share gains. (2) Fostering robust, transparent and collaborative relationships with stakeholders, including regulators, with proactive engagement on industry developments (including constructive engagement on the Skilled Person Review outcome and establishment of customer remediation and system and control improvement programmes). (5) Strategy execution: completion of Phase Two of Business Simplification programme (£52m run-rate savings vs £50m target; total £97m since 2022); operating margin improvement from 22% (2022) to 30% (2025); Quilter brand campaign in Q4; continued delivery of Strategic Adviser Transformation and Wealth Management Transformation programmes; execution of multiple complementary acquisitions; development of AI capabilities. (6) Responsible leadership: inclusion and diversity progress (39% female in senior roles vs 40% target; 7% ethnically diverse vs 6% prior year); colleague engagement at record high of 8.2/10 (vs 8.0 in 2024, ahead of internal target and external Financial Services benchmark).
additional_conditions: The Committee assessed performance holistically against key personal objectives, strategy execution and responsible leadership.
